name: Epidaurum
notes: DRAFT. The nearest Roman town up the coast.

name: Narona
notes: DRAFT. River port on the Naro, the grain of the valley.

name: Salona
notes: DRAFT. Capital of the province; the governor of Dalmatia sits here.

name: Iader
notes: DRAFT. Roman colony among the Liburnian islands: salt from the island pans, fish and island fleece.

name: Pola
notes: DRAFT. Colonia Pietas Iulia Pola in Istria: famous olive oil, and Istrian stone.

name: Aquileia
notes: DRAFT. End of the Amber Road from the Baltic; Noric iron from the Alps.

name: Ancon
notes: DRAFT. Greek city on the Italian shore, across the open sea: Picene grain, and a purple dye said to rival Tyre's.

name: Dyrrachium
notes: DRAFT. Start of the Via Egnatia to the east.

name: Brundisium
notes: DRAFT. The gate to Italy and the East.
